output.title: DNS response caching in FindZoneByFqdn: can't tell if this environment uses it
output.content: The release note (ev-d4918828336e) only says that `FindZoneByFqdn` now caches the full DNS response and handles TTL expiration. It doesn't say which component or issuer setup calls this function. The environment shows `cert-manager.io/v1 Certificate` manifests and the `certificates.cert-manager.io` CRD, but no Issuer or ClusterIssuer manifests or solver configuration, so there's no way to tell whether this environment reaches this code path. To decide, the operator should check their issuer and challenge-solver setup against PR #7596.
